verification_report.summary: The proof is correct and complete. It verifies the conjugation action and the orbit-centralizer formula, shows that every non-singleton conjugacy class has size divisible by p, applies the class equation to deduce that p divides |Z(G)|, and then concludes that Z(G) contains a nonidentity element. The statement is self-contained, and the proof contains no prohibited justification patterns or references requiring external validation.
